text: The rollout of the Vacant Home Tax in 2024 was not communicated well enough to clearly inform residents of the annual requirement. Many residents also declared and still received a tax bill. There is no proper receipting or confirmation process for those declaring online, and no proper communication on advising residents to declare yearly. There was a commitment by the City Manager to bring the 2025 process through committee.
Item MM17.1 was ruled redundant by the Speaker at City Council on April 17 and 18, 2024.
